intro: The questions our wholesale and private-label partners ask most. If yours isn't here, contact us and we'll answer it directly.

items.a: Organica Group is a Moroccan manufacturer and exporter of organic beauty and cosmetic products. Our range includes cosmetic and culinary argan oil, prickly pear seed oil, Moroccan black soap (Savon Noir / Beldi), ghassoul (rhassoul) clay, rose water, Nila and Aker Fassi powders, Sidr powder, black seed oil, essential oils, and finished skincare and haircare products — all available in bulk and for private label.

Our office is in the Sidi Ghanem industrial zone in Marrakesh (Lot 377 N°3/6, 40110 Marrakesh), and our factory is in Agadir, within Morocco's main argan-producing region. We source directly from Moroccan producers and cooperatives.

We have 10+ years of experience, have shipped over 1 million units, process 500+ tonnes of raw material annually from a 50,000 sq ft climate-controlled facility, and maintain a 99% client-satisfaction rate across 50+ countries.

items.q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.a: Our standard MOQ is 100 units. It applies across the wholesale and private-label range, so new partners can enter the market without committing to very large volumes.

items.q: Can I request a sample before ordering?
items.a: Yes. We can provide samples so you can check quality, scent, texture and packaging before confirming a full order.

items.q: How do I place an order or get a quote?
items.a: Use the "Get a Quote" form on the site, or contact us directly at inquiry@moroccanorganica.com or WhatsApp +212 648-273228. Include the product, quantity, packaging or bottle size, destination country, and whether you need private label, so we can prepare an accurate quote quickly.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept secure online payments including PayPal and Stripe. For larger bulk and export orders, payment and shipping terms such as FOB, CIF or DDP can be agreed with our team.

items.q: Do you offer private label and OEM services?
items.a: Yes — end-to-end private label and OEM. We add your logo and branding to bottles or bulk packaging, offer custom and ready-to-use packaging, and our professional design team develops your label and brand identity. We've completed 460+ private label projects to date.

Bulk packaging for formulators, retail-ready bottles and jars, and fully custom private-label packaging through partner factories approved for the US and European markets. A range of ready-to-use standard packaging is also available.

Yes. Our products are supported by certifications including USDA Organic, AB (Agriculture Biologique), FDA registration, EACCE, and verification by the Marrakech Chamber of Commerce. Certificates of Analysis (COA) and Safety Data Sheets (SDS) are available for export compliance.

items.q: Which countries do you export to?
items.a: We export worldwide and have served 50+ countries, including the USA, UK, Canada, France, Netherlands, Australia, Japan, South Korea, China, Malaysia, India, Pakistan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and South Africa. Argan oil ships by air cargo with short transit times.

items.q: How can I tell authentic argan oil from a fake?
items.a: Authentic cosmetic argan oil is cold-pressed Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil — light nutty scent, dull golden colour, non-greasy finish — and the label should list only Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil. An olive-oil smell, bright clear colour, or a very low price all suggest dilution.
